mapper.sql: id, workspace_name, workspace_code, workspace_type, description, feature, status, creator, gmt_create, gmt_modified
mapper.select: SELECT FROM teapot_workspace WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM teapot_workspace WHERE workspace_code = #{code} LIMIT 1

SELECT w.id, w.workspace_name, w.workspace_code, w.workspace_type, w.description, w.feature, w.status, w.creator, w.gmt_create, w.gmt_modified FROM teapot_workspace w JOIN teapot_workspace_member m ON m.workspace_id = w.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND w.status = 1 ORDER BY w.id
SELECT FROM teapot_workspace WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teapot_workspace (workspace_name, workspace_code, workspace_type, description, feature, status, creator) VALUES (#{workspaceName}, #{workspaceCode}, #{workspaceType}, #{description}, #{feature}, #{status}, #{creator})
mapper.update: UPDATE teapot_workspace SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teapot_workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT member_role FROM teapot_workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.user_id, m.member_role, u.username, u.real_name FROM teapot_workspace_member m LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY FIELD(m.member_role, 'owner', 'member'), m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teapot_workspace_member (workspace_id, user_id, member_role, creator) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{memberRole}, #{creator})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM teapot_workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
